I am Kim Ki-hong, Director of the ANCHOR Project Group at Choonhae Health Sciences University.
울산은 대한민국 산업 발전을 이끌어 온 도시이자, 이제는 초고령사회 진입: Ulsan has long driven Korea's industrial development, and now faces new challenges: entry into a super-aged society, the outflow of young people, and growing demand for medical care and caregiving. Building a city where every citizen can stay healthy, learn, work and remain where they live has become a shared task for the region and its universities.
춘해보건대학교는 1968년 개교 이래 보건의료 전문인력 양성에 힘써 온: Since its founding in 1968, Choonhae Health Sciences University has been dedicated to training healthcare professionals as Ulsan's only university specialized in health sciences. Under the vision of "Building a CH-U-RISE-based, region-tailored innovation ecosystem for win-win cooperation in healthcare and human services," we are vigorously carrying out the Regional Growth Talent Development (ANCHOR) Project together with Ulsan Metropolitan City.
앵커사업단은 \"돌봄은 늘, 배움은 계속, 성공은 모두의 것\"이라는 슬: As our slogan "Care always, learning continues, success for all" expresses, the ANCHOR Project Group aims to build an Ulsan where talent drops anchor and stays. Through 8 unit tasks across the four Dynamic TALENT·BRIDGE·JUMP·CARE projects, we support the growth of every member of the community — from students and workers to adult learners, international students, children and seniors.
이를 위해 CH-U-RUN센터, 건강안전지원센터, AI헬스케어빅데이터센터: To this end, centered on the CH-U-RUN Center, Health & Safety Support Center, AI Healthcare Big Data Center, Tree Diagnosis Center, Industry Collaboration Center and Korean Language Education Center, we are focusing all our capabilities on developing region-tailored professionals, industry-academia cooperation that grows with companies, lifelong and vocational education across the life cycle, and support for the region's health, care and safety.
그러나 앵커사업의 성과는 대학의 노력만으로 완성되지 않습니다. 울산광역시: Yet the ANCHOR Project cannot succeed through the university's efforts alone. Only with the interest and participation of Ulsan Metropolitan City, local medical and welfare institutions, industry, partner universities in the southeast region, and citizens can it lead to real change in the region. We will always communicate openly and be a reliable partner walking alongside the community.
춘해보건대학교가 지역과 함께 성장하는 보건의료·휴먼서비스 혁신대학으로 나: We kindly ask for your warm encouragement and support as Choonhae Health Sciences University moves forward as an innovative university in healthcare and human services that grows together with the region.

2025년 시작된 「지역혁신중심 대학지원체계(RISE·라이즈)」를 교육부: It took its current name in April 2026, when the Ministry of Education restructured the Regional Innovation System & Education (RISE) program launched in 2025 around students and talent. Metropolitan governments directly foster universities in line with regional development strategies, and the Ministry adjusts support based on reviews and performance.
